subject: Leadership discovery recap & procurement on-ramp for Veridian Systems
messages:
From: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@veridian.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@veridian.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's leadership discovery

Sean / team —

Thanks again for taking time with our execs today. Quick notes from our side and a couple of asks so we have aligned next steps. High-level pain / goals we called out on the call: 

- Pain: Large volume of customer support tickets and claims where our existing NLU pipeline loses context after a few turns; inconsistent entity extraction across channels.
- Goal: Reduce mean handle time by ~25% on NLU-driven triage and improve entity extraction F1 by at least 10 points in the first 90 days.
- Risk: Data residency (EHR-adjacent PII) and auditability for clinical workflows — procurement & security will need evidence early.

Can you send a short post-call recap that: (1) confirms the above, (2) proposes a 60-day pilot scope, and (3) lists what evidence you can share for SOC2 / encryption / logging? Natalie will loop in procurement once we have a scope + SOW.

Thanks —
Michael Lowe
VP Product, Veridian Systems

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@veridian.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's leadership discovery

Michael —

Appreciate the clear framing. Below is a concise recap from our side plus concrete next steps and a proposed on-ramp for procurement. Attaching a short deck and a draft pilot scope for your review (redwood-postcall-deck.pdf; pilot-scope-draft.docx).

Recap (confirming what we heard)
- Primary pain: Context loss across multi-turn conversations leading to lower automation rates and higher manual reviews.
- Business outcomes: Target ~25% reduction in mean handle time; establish a reliable extraction pipeline so downstream automation can safely take action on ~30–40% of cases.
- Constraints: PII/EHR adjacency, retention limits, and a preference for vendor tech that can run in a VPC or private deployment if required.

Pilot proposal (60-day, measurable guardrails)
- Week 0–2: Data intake & alignment — sample logs, schema mapping, and success metrics (MHT, extraction F1).
- Week 3–5: Model tuning & integration — deploy a Redwood-hosted pilot variant with KV caching and prefix caching for sessions; integrate inference endpoints into one selected workflow.
- Week 6–8: Validation & ops handoff — measure metrics vs baseline, run safety/regression checks, playbook for fallback to rule-based systems.
- Acceptance criteria: +10 F1 on entity extract OR >=25% reduction in MHT; no critical PII leakage events in test traces.

Procurement on-ramp (recommended)
- Deliverable 1: Pilot SOW + pricing bands (we'll issue a draft SOW within 48 business hours after you confirm stakeholders).
- Deliverable 2: Security evidence pack (SOC2 summary, encryption details, audit log samples).
- Timeline ask: If procurement can start parallel review this week, we can target pilot start in ~3 weeks.

Risks & mitigations- Data residency: Option for VPC/private deployment or encrypted-in-transit+at-rest with customer-managed keys.
- Regression risk: We'll run a baseline eval and use Redwood Optimize to set quantization and batching that preserve quality.

Next steps (short concrete asks)
1) Can you confirm the procurement contact (procurement@veridian.com works) and target committee date?
2) Please confirm the pilot scope above or flag changes; we will push an SOW draft and a one-page CFO exec summary.
3) Natalie/your security lead — would you like the SOC2 summary first or the SOW? Either is fine but SOC2 tends to accelerate procurement checks.

Best —
Sean Gallagher
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-postcall-deck.pdf; pilot-scope-draft.docx

Date: 2027-05-18T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's leadership discovery

Hi Michael —

Quick follow from the security/compliance angle (wanted to put these items in one thread so procurement has everything). Sharing a short SOC2 summary we can use for initial procurement review (attached: SOC2-summary.pdf). Highlights: 

- Coverage: SOC 2 Type II (controls relevant to security, availability, confidentiality).
- Data flow: We can restrict telemetry to anonymized traces; for EHR-adjacent data we recommend a VPC/private deployment with customer-managed KMS.
- Logging & retention: Configurable per-customer retention windows; we provide immutable audit logs and an export for compliance audits.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, and support for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

For procurement: if you want a redline-friendly statement about liability limits and data handling (for inclusion in the SOW/T&C), tell us your target retention windows and we will include it in the draft.

I'll be on standby to join any procurement/security calls early next week.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Principal Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

Sean / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear recap and fast turnaround on the attachments. This lines up with what our CFO and procurement will need to start a formal review. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@veridian.com (I've looped them above).
- Timeline: target procurement committee meeting on 2027-06-07 — if you can get an SOW and pricing bands in the next 3 business days that helps.
- Pilot acceptance: the metrics you listed work as acceptance criteria; procurement will want a capped pilot budget and a cancel/rollback clause for data-risk events.

Next asks from us: 
1) Please send the draft SOW and a 1-page CFO exec summary (cost/benefit bullets) by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-20).
2) Kimberly — SOC2-summary looks good; procurement may ask for an MSA-level liability statement for the SOW.
3) Sean / Ben — can you provide an initial pricing band for a 60-day pilot (estimate range + any add-ons) in the SOW?

We can schedule a 30-minute procurement / security sync next week if useful. I'll coordinate with procurement and get a time.

Best —
Michael Lowe
VP Product, Veridian Systems
